no_adcom_quote.quote: FDA did not refer this new drug application to an advisory committee as no significant efficacy or safety issues were identified during the review that required external input for the proposed indication.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for TUKYSA (tucatinib, NDA213411). Section 9 of the FDA Multidisciplinary Review states the FDA did not refer the application to an advisory committee because no significant efficacy or safety issues requiring external input were identified during the review. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
